story: Judge dismisses majority of GitHub Copilot copyright claims
text: There are legendary Prodigy tracks reconstructions by Jim Pavloff, see: 1. "Smack my bitch up" [LINK] 2. "Voodoo people" [VIDEO] Those pieces sound exactly the same as the original, but it does not violate copyright because they've been produced by hand. Mind blowing!

story: Ask HN: What are your music prototyping solutions?
